<div class="card-body">
'''Anakin's Lightsaber''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">アナキンのライトセーバー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">能力値＞3のスカイウォーカーにフォースを消費せずに配備する。キャラクターがいる場所のフォース消耗に＋1。フォースを消費せずに起動する。キャラクターを目標とする。運命数を2枚引く。運命数の合計＞能力値なら、キャラクターに命中し、目標は没収値＝0となる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Hoth-Japanese-Anakins-Lightsaber-encyclopedia32-p43-f7f919c08432.jpeg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">アナキン・スカイウォーカーが作ったライトセーバー。ルークに手渡すべく、オビーワンが保管していた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Anakin's Lightsaber

'''Card text:''' Deploy without spending Force on a Skywalker with ability &gt; 3. Add 1 to Force drains at the location where the character is. Use without spending Force. Target a character. Draw two destiny. If total destiny &gt; ability, the character is hit and the target's forfeit becomes 0.

'''Lore:''' A lightsaber made by Anakin Skywalker. Obi-Wan kept it in order to hand it over to Luke.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese printing states the Force-drain bonus and the free weapon use in separate sentences.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Anakin's Lightsaber]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
